entry.title: Guess the codebase: 8 engineering lessons from one open-source repo
entry.summary: A series: eight engineering lessons from one open-source codebase. Guess which repo.

entry.title: Guess the codebase #1: Decide, commit, then act
entry.summary: The three-step server pattern that keeps AI agents from leaving your app in a weird state.

entry.title: Guess the codebase #2: Performance budgets belong in unit tests
entry.summary: Seven performance patterns from one repo's commit log, and why their budgets fail the build.

entry.title: Guess the codebase #3: Mock the boundary, not the logic
entry.summary: “A test that needs a timeout to pass is wrong.” Testing rules from a repo that bans sleeps.

entry.title: Guess the codebase #4: A PR process for the AI era
entry.summary: When anyone can generate a 2,000-line PR in ten minutes, review time is what you protect.

entry.title: Guess the codebase #5: Turn taste into lint rules
entry.summary: Review comments don't scale. A repo with 14 custom lint rules shows what does.

entry.title: Guess the codebase #6: A dev setup built for ten agents on one laptop
entry.summary: Ports, databases, processes and URLs: everything shared becomes a collision once agents run in parallel.

entry.title: Guess the codebase #7: Lying spinners, stale labels, one-way doors
entry.summary: UX rules from a repo whose users stare at it all day and notice every lie the UI tells.

entry.title: Guess the codebase #8: Write docs for your most frequent contributor
entry.summary: In this repo, the most frequent contributor is an AI agent running inside the app itself.
